_meta.method: in-session maker-checker (Workflow tool, no API key). One agent per 40 rows classified into given_name / surname / place_name / other_proper_noun / fragment / misspelling / interjection / ordinary_word / unsure, and wrote pos + definition for the last two; every proposal was re-judged by an independent checker asked whether the row is definable at all.
